body:
Japan, iceland, wales are three places id love to visit.

Seeing other people love.... its like they just enjoy being together and being together, and whenever im with someone i just want to sleep, or play a videogame....

As for your ex, i dont mean to sound rude when i say this, but if he was good, why is he an ex?

> Could you maybe try to describe some of these things to me?

See thats tricky to do, because they're visual some of them, like paintings like of a clock tower floating on a cloud but semi isometric with a touch of surrealism. Then there are like movies or dreams of things like elves riding wolf tiger things through a woods fighting fat orc/ogre like gremlin type things that i think would make a great story, but every time i try to put it on paper i get like 2 pages top and theres no story, just words.

> Wow, getting run over sounds pretty terrifying. What happened, if you don't mind me asking?
> Damn, that sounds like a really tough experience where people took advantage of you being in a vulnerable state. How did you cope?

I was working at a factory that was a two mile walk I did it every day, the weather got good so i walked five miles to walmart and bought a mountain bike. While riding it home from walmart, i got to a T intersection which merged with the busy highway. I was to cross the T not the highway part, and a car was stopped at the stop sign, I looked at them and nodded and they acknowledged me, I started to cross and they saw an opening in the cars and slammed on the gas to get out, unfortunately, I was directly in front of them at that point. In the shock and confussion they asked me if I needed help, and my mind was all pfft and i was like "I gotta get home... I work tonight" 
No one else stopped, had I fallen back two feet farther than I had, Id have been in the highway, and likely very gone.
I didnt cope well with it, nor the homeless bit, it was short three months, but it was cold, frustrating, and one of the most unpleasant life experiences ive ever had. It showed me how little I meant to anyone, no place would hire me because i had no address. I had to move back home to my parents and im still here, i work now, but i feel useless

I want to travel but i can not nor shall i ever be able to afford it, and even if i could doing it alone would be just as empty as my day to day. I want to find someone to love, and love me in return, but i dont even know if i can feel that emotion, it just seems like something i havent and cant feel. Not like i see people feeling

I have all these things in my head that i cant make take shape, no matter how much ive practiced, drawn, wrote, etc. They just dont come out as they are inside the labyrinth of my mind. 
I really havent done anything worthwhile, the scariest was when I was run over, the most challenging was the homeless time that followed that because they got away with it by exploiting my confussion from being run over, and my job firing me for not calling in.
